events.title: Demo Update v0.1.3: Furniture & a Halloween Event
events.summary: Thanks for playing the SUSHI PARADE demo! The demo has been updated to v0.1.3 (Steam updates it automatically). events.title: Demo Update v0.1.2: Sushi Names on Order Tickets & Hungrier Customers
events.summary: Thanks for playing the SUSHI PARADE demo! The demo has been updated to v0.1.2. Steam will update it for you automatically. Sushi names on order tickets A customer's order ticket now shows the name of the sushi they want, right alongside its picture. Look-alike sushi are easy to tell apart now. events.title: Our Apologies and a Status Update on the Windows Issue
events.summary: Since the demo launched on October 1, some players on Windows have been unable to control the game properly. I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing. I haven't found the cause yet and am still looking into it. I'm checking whether it depends on things like display scaling or the monitor setup, but I can't say that for sure.
